provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Euthia: Torment of Resurrection rulebook (Steamforged / Galaxy Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Pick a Scenario from the Scenario book (first game: The Hunt)
The Scenario's starting Map tile in the middle (usually the Church without a Priest)
Sort Map tiles by Chapter (back numeral), then by arrow type: Fixed, Encounter, Scenario, Other
Use all Fixed tiles of each Chapter
Solo: use only the 2 Fixed tiles per Chapter shown for the Solo Game
Add the Scenario's tiles and the number of facedown Encounter and Other tiles its preparation table gives for your player count
Shuffle each Chapter facedown; stack them with the highest Chapter at the bottom and Chapter I on top
Each player picks a Hero (Ael, Dral, Keleia, Maeldur, Skoldur, Taesiri) and takes its board and components
steps.note: First time with a Hero: read its Hero sheet

steps.text: Maximum Health token above the highest blood-red slot; a Hero token next to it as current Health
Beside your board: Hero, Action, Trade, Interaction and Damage tokens and your 2 Hero dice
Starting Hero tile(s) faceup on the slot with the matching icon
Other Hero tiles facedown, lowest Reputation on top (only those for your player count)
4 Gaar tokens on your Gaar slots; your standee beside the board
Scenario board aside: random starting player's Hero token on Round 1; everyone's Hero token on Reputation 0
Trade board: Dragonslayer, Alchemist and Merchant tiles each in 2 facedown stacks with 4 faceup beside them
Healing Potion and Grey Sack tiles near the Trade board; room on its left for discards
Shii's Intervention card with the Die of Hope on blank; Reference cards nearby
Encounter cards in a deck (by type); Natural Resource and Treasure tiles shuffled by back; Monster decks by difficulty; Silver and Gold decks
steps.note: Leave out cards with the one-player icon unless playing solo

steps.text: Control cards of the Heroes in play shuffled facedown
Box the Control cards
Solo: 2 dice of another Hero as Monster dice; Combat deck shuffled; swap the Soul Control Gold cards for the one-player ones
Do the Scenario's own setup
Each round: put out 1 Mining, Trade and Combat Action token, ready Items and Abilities, flip Gems active
The starting player never changes
The starting player takes the first turn; then clockwise
